focus: Design the fourth interaction register (data-chart-inert) and its checker enforcement: attribute shape and placement, decision table, migration ordering, proving mutation.

label: The inert register is data-chart-inert on the root <figure>, with the reason in its attribute value (e.g. "every encoded value is printed beside its mark"); precedent for value capture is the data-chart-dim pattern at check-corpus.cjs:1173. It must NOT join INTERACTION_REGISTERS (:1130) because that array drives the :focus:not(:focus-visible) hygiene requirement (:1140), which an inert form owes nothing.

Enforcement decision table: no declaration + no register = pass (silence is not a defect, protects tier-2 forms and unannotated files); no declaration + register = pass (existing hygiene :1140 and fmt() :1214 rules apply unchanged); inert declared + no register = pass; inert with empty value = error; inert + any other register = error (a form cannot both refuse and answer the pointer). Enforced as a sibling branch in checkInteractionState/checkInteractionHygiene, reading the markup region alone.

Migration: the checker ships FIRST. With no template annotated, no file matches either error branch, so the corpus stays green the day the rule lands; the six correctly-inert forms are annotated afterward with their reasons and stay green (none carries another register). daily-range gets no attribute and no static rule can demand or forbid one, because needs-pointer is the packet's judgment about geometry-only encoding, not a markup property.

Proving mutation: add data-chart-inert to the root <figure> of assets/templates/heat-matrix.html (which already carries data-chart-tooltip, verified), run node scripts/check-corpus.cjs from the skill root, expect RESULT: FAILED with the contradiction error, then git restore and expect RESULT: PASSED. Baseline RESULT: PASSED verified this iteration at 0 errors.
A register declaration the checker cannot justify is worse than none: the inert attribute carries its own reason, and an empty reason is itself a checker error.
The checker enforces self-consistency of declarations, never completeness of annotation: silence passes, contradiction errors.
Checker baseline: node check-corpus.cjs from the skill root prints RESULT: PASSED, 0 errors (structural run, no --render).

13 of 21 templates carry at least one of the three existing registers today; heat-matrix.html carries data-chart-tooltip; every template carries data-chart-table (universal, non-discriminating, as established in iteration 1).
